name: strix
description: Portable, risk-aware workflows for planning, structured autoreview, implementation loops, and bug hunting.

interface.longDescription: Strix provides source-grounded planning, independent plan review, isolated structured autoreview, checkpoint implementation loops, branch review, and evidence-based bug hunting for software projects.
defaultPrompt: Review this plan for execution readiness.
Run a structured risk-proportional review of this change.
Execute this approved plan through the implementation loop.
Investigate this feature for concrete bugs.
